acceptanceCriteria: A stub table or fixture imported from a sibling committed module is resolved and its rule applies, with TSA-V0-312 retired or narrowed.
Auto fixtures, globalSetup and in-body seeding suppress VACUOUS-EMPTY-EQUALITY with tests.
A generically named stub module is detected or abstains with a named reason.
bypassCSP mutation is killed; the stale V1-1919 prose is corrected.
body: Residuals of V1-1944 (PR #1210, TSA-V0-300..312): (1) cross-file resolution of stubs, cleanup registries and fixtures is NOT_PRODUCED (TSA-V0-312); the rules abstain with stub-table-cross-file / cleanup-registry-cross-file / fixture-cross-file; (2) auto fixtures, Playwright globalSetup and seeding inside the test body are not modelled for VACUOUS-EMPTY-EQUALITY; (3) the stub-word heuristic (stub/mock/msw/handler/route/fake/intercept) misses stub modules with generic names; (4) the bypassCSP Playwright option entry survives mutation (untested); (5) the V1-1919 failure-mode prose about seeded fixtures (from #1201) is stale after TSA-V0-306.
title: Test-validity: real cross-file stub/fixture resolution, auto fixtures and global setup seeding, generic stub-module names
